title: Shows two panels, But you get only One, I didn’t read the bottom line!
text:
Shows two panels, But you get only One, I didn’t read the bottom line!. This One drape is nice, and will keep the room warm and dark for the winter if that is what your looking for.
The color is a lite gray , pleasing to the eye.

If there was two panels in this package I could hang these on my wood patio Cover to keep out some of the cold and rain for the winter, or cooler weather, And we could sit outside.
I’ll be looking for these with two panels on Amazon. (Found them for the same price on Amazon)

There is a felt like material for the backing.
This said , it is fleece lined, I think of fleece like Ugg boots, it’s not.

Since it shows Two drapes, I assumed that is what is being sold,
Wrong, there is just one. Although at the bottom of the description
It does say, One. There fore it’s my mistake.
I feel it’s kind of tricky to show two drapes as most sell two , Not one!

For one drape this is pricey. You can buy Two for the same price, shop around on Amazon.
